lead-v2-dark.svg: synthwerk-contracts is the one contract of Synthwerk: OpenAPI 3.1 for HTTP, CloudEvents 1.0.2 with JSON Schema for events. CI generates the Go and TypeScript clients and fails every pull request that breaks a consumer. It runs nothing. It only makes promises.

flow-v2-dark.svg: SPEC -> LINT -> GATE -> CLIENTS. A pull request passes all four, or it does not merge.
flow-v2-light.svg: SPEC -> LINT -> GATE -> CLIENTS. A pull request passes all four, or it does not merge.
how-v2-dark.svg: Lint: Spectral checks names, security and size limits. A selftest proves that each rule fires. Breaking: oasdiff on the APIs, eventcompat on the events, both against the PR base. Selftest: A fixture PR renames a required field. CI expects the gate to fail on it. Drift: CI generates the clients again and fails when the committed code differs
how-v2-light.svg: Lint: Spectral checks names, security and size limits. A selftest proves that each rule fires. Breaking: oasdiff on the APIs, eventcompat on the events, both against the PR base. Selftest: A fixture PR renames a required field. CI expects the gate to fail on it. Drift: CI generates the clients again and fails when the committed code differs
api-v2-dark.svg: GET /healthz: The process runs. 200 with status ok. GET /readyz: One result per dependency. ok or degraded: 200. down: 503. pulse.target.status_changed.v1: Pulse saw a new readiness status of a target. llm.toolcall.executed.v1: Audit fact: the AI called one read-only MCP tool
